references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses - a common introductory formula that introduces divine commands and instructions throughout the books of Moses.
The same introductory formula is used at the beginning of Leviticus, where the Lord speaks to Moses from the tent of meeting.
An identical introductory formula introducing the laws concerning the sin offering, which are closely related to the guilt offering in chapter 5.
The Lord speaks to Moses - the same formal introduction to divine revelation found throughout the Torah.
Continues the instructions on the sacrificial service with the same introductory formula, showing the continuity of the divine revelation to Moses.
Another occurrence of the standardized formula where the Lord speaks to Moses, introducing further regulations concerning offerings.
